integerSemantics: Solidity integer arithmetic. Division floors toward zero; quantities here are nonnegative. Checked arithmetic and int128 casts can revert on overflow.

custodyBoundaries.rule: An Enclave can own a veBTC NFT while only an explicit active EnclaveDebtManager pledge makes its locked amount institutional debt collateral. Custody, pledge, voting power, and beneficial economic attribution remain distinct.

formulas.expression: slope = floor(amount / maxLockSeconds); power = at >= lockEnd ? 0 : slope * (lockEnd - at)
formulas.rounding: The amount-to-slope division floors before multiplication. This is not algebraically interchangeable with floor(amount * remaining / maxLockSeconds).

formulas.expression: boostedAmount = boost == 0 ? amount : floor(amount * boost / boostPrecision); virtualSlope = floor(boostedAmount / maxLockSeconds); power = at >= lockEnd ? 0 : virtualSlope * (lockEnd - at)
unboosted power = amount; boosted power = boost == 0 ? amount : floor(amount * boost / boostPrecision)
